answers.core: There has to be someone else out there who has encountered a need for something like this. Filtering on element properties is already a thing, and is valuable to most everyone. Deeper filtering just seems like another useful step.
answers.workaround: I suppose it could be worked around, and it could likely be avoided entirely by a different project structure. It's just something that has bugged me for a while, and it's only getting more frustrating as my project grows.

title: Add support for filterable arrays in the inspector
